status: Dated exploratory extension after prior consensus results were examined; not preregistered or confirmatory
target: Nature Communications with clinical validation framing
authorization: User requested all three layers of analyses and training, using existing public data only
primary_question: How do source training scale, local positive-label resources and adaptation strategy jointly affect discrimination, calibration and threshold reliability?
existing_controls: Reuse verified 66 source models, including 18 fixed 20000-update unweighted DenseNet models and 18 ResNet controls
new_source_loss_control: Six DenseNet121 runs at the existing patient-defined 10000-image subsets, two sources and three original seeds, subset-weighted masked BCE, identical 20000-update protocol and final checkpoint; pair with six completed unweighted controls
weighted_loss: positive weight clip(n_negative/n_positive,1,20), computed only from source training subset
reference: Official consensus 1000-image calibration and 2000-image assessment roles remain unchanged; VinDr 15000 is a previously evaluated three-reader development benchmark
local_composition: Exploratory positive-only threshold calibration at 5,10,20,29,40 positive images, sampled without replacement from the fixed calibration pool; case enrichment is not used to estimate population probability calibration
local_classifier_training: For the six full-scale matched models, freeze backbone and fit a new linear head on the existing 3000-image VinDr development calibration pool using majority labels. Budgets 250,500,1000,2000, three fixed sampling seeds. Fixed ridge logistic C=0.01 with source feature scaling learned only on the head fitting subset. Compare unweighted and balanced head fitting. Consensus 1000 calibrates the adapted model; consensus 2000 evaluates. Training and calibration label mechanisms differ and are reported.
head_scope: Local linear-head retraining; not end-to-end target fine-tuning. The 12000-image VinDr development assessment remains excluded from fitting.
clinical_role: Exploratory additional-review flag for radiographic pleural effusion while routine interpretation continues; target sensitivity is a research operating target, not a validated clinical requirement
decision_analysis: Threshold strategies evaluated for hypothetical missed-positive to false-positive costs of 5,10,20,50. Report cost-weighted errors on study reference labels, never real clinical net benefit or workload savings. No treatment decision curve without a supported clinical action.
uncertainty: Shared paired assessment bootstrap with 2000 repeats conditional on fixed fitted models; separate three-seed SD; joint calibration and assessment bootstrap 500 repeats at full local pool to assess adaptation sampling uncertainty. Overlapping subsamples are not independent cohorts and their quantiles are not confidence intervals.
failure_reporting: Preserve every fit and threshold request including class scarcity, optimizer failure and order-statistic infeasibility; show denominators and conditional performance
model_selection: No selection or tuning against assessment labels. All specified sources, seeds and methods reported; negative or null findings retained.
claims: No universal sample size recommendation, no new order-statistic theorem, no new architecture, no new hospital validation, no clinical outcome claim
preservation: Legacy salts, partitions, checkpoints and delivered manuscripts remain unchanged
